methodology.code_identity: For every row, HIP, HipGraph, and Redline load exactly the same hipcc code object selected by the recorded wave policy. Vulkan runs matched GLSL algorithms compiled for RADV.
methodology.correctness: Every timed sequence is reset before timing and checked against a CPU oracle after its final sample. Only four-way correctness-passing rows are ranked.
methodology.redline_dependency: Required RMW edges use wait_compute_idle plus the RADV-global gfx12 acquire policy. Independent single-stage and aggressive single-kernel tapes contain no dependency fence; their system ownership acquire occurs outside timing.

timers.hipgraph: HIP device events around graph replay

timing_modes.independent_throughput: Disjoint output slices with no inter-operation dependency; HIP and Vulkan use up to four queues/streams while Redline uses one retained IB. Single-stage Redline rows omit dependency fences from the timed IB.
timing_modes.serial_latency: One true output RMW chain. Every operation is separated by the backend's required compute-write to compute-read/write dependency.
timing_modes.single_kernel_aggressive: Exactly one dispatch and one output operation. Redline's timed retained IB contains no entry acquire or dependency fence; the HIP-to-PM4 ownership acquire is replayed and waited outside the GPU timestamp window. Two-stage rows are excluded.

methodology.vulkan_memory: Device-local buffers with staging transfers outside the timing window.

wave_policy.all_wave32: Every HIP-family row selects the wave32 code object.
wave_policy.blanket_wave64: Every kernel family with any prior Vulkan-over-Redline row selects wave64.
wave_policy.radiowave_tuned: The targeted kernels plus every VOPD variant select wave64; dispatch_tiny uses one 32-lane workgroup because only lane zero is live; interleave selects scalar-buffer loads for independent throughput and B128 loads with a four-wave HIP workgroup for aggressive latency while Vulkan retains its native shader geometry.
wave_policy.targeted_wave64: Only q4_selected_dual, q6_x8, dense_q8, and vopd_dependent select wave64.
